verdict.rationale: v0 is fundamentally a natural-language, chat-driven code/app generation tool: users describe what they want ('Build me a personal website') and v0 plans tasks, generates code, connects to databases, and deploys — all via conversational prompts rather than manual commands, corroborated by both docs and hands-on community use building a full MVP via prompting. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of command coverage/robustness across complex multi-step natural-language instructions, and no evidence of voice or non-chat NL interfaces beyond text prompts.
